title: CSS modules: webpack/css-loader-compatible scoped-name hashing
author: sciyoshi
summary: Adds webpack-style `[algo:hash:digest:length]` placeholders, md4/xxhash deps, and hash_prefix/hash_local_name config (Rust + JS API) to make scoped names byte-identical to css-loader. Large new public surface for a migration use case; the author offered to keep it in a fork. Currently has merge conflicts.
evidence: devongovett 2026-05-17: "Not necessarily opposed to adding these, but isn't the whole point of CSS modules that the scoped names are not predictable?" plus inline review; author addressed comments 2026-05-18 (removed escapeScopedNames) and said: "we're happy to keep it in a fork ... you can take only the pieces that feel useful". mergeable_state=dirty. Changes Segment::Hash shape (public Rust API) and adds JS config fields. #660 (per-class [hash], 6 reactions) is the most-requested piece.
decision: Do we want full css-loader hash parity in core (new md4/xxhash deps, Segment::Hash change, new JS options), only a subset such as per-local-name hashing (#660) and hash length, or none of it?
